# Lab 13.9: Cloud AI Service Functions

## What We Are Going to Do
Use task-specific Cloud AI APIs from SQL: sentiment with Natural Language, translation, image labels with Vision, and speech transcription.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable the APIs and grant the connection access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable language.googleapis.com translate.googleapis.com vision.googleapis.com speech.googleapis.com
SA=$(bq show --format=json --connection $PROJECT_ID.us.lab_conn | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['cloudResource']['serviceAccountId'])")
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$SA --role=roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Sentiment with Natural Language.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab13.nlp
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (remote_service_type = 'CLOUD_AI_NATURAL_LANGUAGE_V1');

SELECT text_content, ml_understand_text_result
FROM ML.UNDERSTAND_TEXT(MODEL lab13.nlp,
  (SELECT review AS text_content FROM lab13.reviews LIMIT 5),
  STRUCT('analyze_sentiment' AS nlu_option));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Translate to Hindi.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab13.translate
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (remote_service_type = 'CLOUD_AI_TRANSLATE_V3');

SELECT text_content, ml_translate_result
FROM ML.TRANSLATE(MODEL lab13.translate,
  (SELECT title AS text_content FROM `bigquery-public-data.bbc_news.fulltext` LIMIT 5),
  STRUCT('translate_text' AS translate_mode, 'hi' AS target_language_code));</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Label images with Vision.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab13.vision
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (remote_service_type = 'CLOUD_AI_VISION_V1');

SELECT uri, ml_annotate_image_result
FROM ML.ANNOTATE_IMAGE(MODEL lab13.vision, TABLE lab10.pet_images, STRUCT(['label_detection'] AS vision_features))
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[SQL] Transcribe audio.** `ML.TRANSCRIBE` uses a Speech-to-Text v2 remote model (`remote_service_type = 'CLOUD_AI_SPEECH_TO_TEXT_V2'`) over an audio object table such as `lab13.audio`. Documents use `CLOUD_AI_DOCUMENT_V1` with a Document AI processor and `ML.PROCESS_DOCUMENT`.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Natural Language | Sentiment score and magnitude |
| Translate | Hindi titles |
| Vision | Labels with confidence |
| When to use | Fixed tasks where a specialised API is cheaper than Gemini |
